target: acceptance 7 — the override must be the DECLARED key, not any mention of the word. Loosening the grep to match 'override' anywhere left every case passing.
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/irreversible/drop_column.md" loose.md; printf -- "\n- we considered an override here but decided against it\n" >> loose.md; v=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible loose.md 2>/dev/null); c=$?; vo=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible "$FIXTURES/irreversible/overridden.md" 2>/dev/null); printf '{"loose":"%s","c":%s,"declared":"%s"}' "$v" "$c" "$vo"
